paragraphs.text: Rendall was a human ornithopter pilot from Penregon during the time of the Brothers' War .

Rendall was Sanwell 's younger brother, stationed in the palace as a cadet in the Kroog ornithopter corps. Sanwell worried about Rendall during the Fall of Kroog , describing his brother as not being suited for fighting and expressing his concern for his safety amidst the chaos and violence of the invasion. Tawnos reassured Sanwell that Rendall, being part of the thopter corps, was likely to be evacuated with Urza 's forces, suggesting that he might be out of immediate danger. Tawnos later ensured that Rendall escaped Kroog carrying the Jalum Tome .
By 31 AR, Sanwell, Rendall and Richlau attended the newly opened school in Penregon . By 36 AR, the two brothers were counted as senior students.
